up: Retrieve the ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, standard value, standard units, and standard type for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4649972. Only include exact measurements where the standard relation is '='. Join activities with assays on assay_id, filter assays by chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649972', and join compound_structures and molecule_dictionary on molregno to get the canonical SMILES and ChEMBL ID for each compound.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_type FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649972' AND a.standard_relation = '='
